title: Ask who is speaking when ego sounds ordinary
summary: Ego weakens when its voice is questioned instead of trusted. Interrogate the voice before you obey it.
takeaway: Interrogate the voice before you obey it.
lifeApplication: When self-importance rises in the throat or chest, pause before the sentence forms and ask who is speaking. Do not grant that urgency the status of truth.

source.shortMeaning: Ego weakens when its voice is questioned instead of trusted.
source.lifeApplication: When ego flares, ask who is speaking before you let that voice lead.
